courseTitle: Victorian Britain — Steam Railways, Factories, Workhouses and Classrooms (1837–1901)
disclaimer: The History Revision Hub — Key Stage 2 Primary History Mind Map.

root.label: Victorian Britain
root.gloss: Sixty-three transformative years under Queen Victoria — from Brunel’s steam railways, the 1840 Penny Black, cotton-mill scavengers, and the 1842 Mines Act to Hyde Park’s Crystal Palace, 1870 Board Schools, seaside Bank Holidays, and 1901.
